summary: Galaxy Digital Inc. filed an 8-K announcing an Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies, BNY Mellon Capital Markets, and UBS for an at-the-market offering of up to $500 million of its Class A common stock. The shares will be sold at market prices through ordinary brokers' transactions or negotiated deals, with agents receiving up to 3.0% commission. This is a routine shelf takedown for capital raising, not a special situation. The ATM allows gradual equity issuance with no fixed price, premium, or definitive timeline. Watch for dilution management and market reception of the program.
